title: refactor(web): rebuild the repository panel in the mockup's sentence layout
body:
Opening a repository showed four stat tiles, switches with paragraphs and a check gallery, nothing like mockup D's panel. The panel now follows the mockup: header and one meta line, Posting as two radio cards, Triage switches, one "Checks · N on" list where every check, built in or custom, is a sentence with its values inline and a switch on the right, then Actions, Roles, the merge threshold as a sentence, Preview, and the stat tiles last.

## What changed

- One checks list and one feel: custom checks are rows in the same list with an editable name, their kind's wording, inline parameters and a × to remove; "Add a check" opens the kind list inline and inserts a row. No separate custom section, no Edit buttons, no parameter popover (the check popover is now method, weekly stats and a jump link).
- Contract: `CustomCheck.enabled?: boolean` (stored only when false). Switched-off customs leave `classificationSources`, so the workflow does not evaluate them and an action naming one is skipped as "off in this pack". One shared `checkOn` rule drives the count, the verdict sentence and the "off" marker.
- The issue tracker has no "off" option; a saved "off" shows as the switch off. The issue label control is gone because nothing evaluates it.
- Posting cards use a fieldset; values stay with their nouns; number fields keep typed text; action sentences wrap.

## Verification

- `bun run check`; `bun test apps/web`; `bun --conditions=intx-src test packages/triage-contracts packages/triage-workflows/src/logic`.
- Browser pass on a local hub and portal at 1280: the panel matches the mockup's order and style, custom checks sit in the one list with their switches, action rows wrap without clipping.

Closes CL-XXXX
